name: Spriggan Bully

spells.name: Shatter
spells.text:
A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

---

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

spells.name: Fear
spells.text:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

---

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The target is Frightened 3 and Fleeing for 1 round.

---

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

spells.name: Light
spells.text:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

Spell Effect: Light

---

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

items.name: Enraged Growth
items.text:
Trigger The spriggan bully takes damage

---
Effect The spriggan bully grows to Large size, along with their equipment (which returns to natural size if removed). The spriggan bully's reach increases by 5 feet. They regain 5 healing Hit Points and gain a +2 status bonus to melee attacks and damage rolls. This effect continues until the end of the spriggan bully's next turn, but on any turn in which the spriggan bully deals damage to another creature and is not Fatigued, the effect extends until the end of the following turn.

When Enraged Growth ends, the spriggan bully is fatigued for 1 hour.

items.name: Bully's Bludgeon
items.text: The spriggan bully makes a morningstar Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll. This attack is nonlethal.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.text: The spriggan bully's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

text:
The typical spriggan is a bully who prefers to take live prisoners in fights, but only to ensure that they have a large stock of living victims to torment, tease, and abuse. They train to use their weapons in nonlethal, but still painful, ways.

---
When gnomes left the First World, many embraced and adapted to life in the Universe, but not all were so resilient. Those who instead hardened their hearts in this time formed insular communities that prioritized survival by any means necessary. Over generations, these communities lost their interest in joy and beauty, diverging into sour creatures called spriggans. In exchange for this loss, they gained an immunity to the Bleaching and the ability to grow in size for short periods of time to increase their odds of survival—or better menace their victims. Over time, spriggans' culture of ruthless pragmatism has become one of sadistic cruelty, their only joy derived from visiting harm upon others.
